IGUI_IMPORT_ZONE: Import. Use this after selecting export to load the local text file into the current zones.
IGUI_EXPORT_ZONE: Export. Select this to open a local text file, modifying that file will not modify the zones in game, use import to apply changes.
IGUI_ZoneAPI_AddZone_Tooltip: Click then drag on the map to draw a new zone.
IGUI_ZoneAPI_ZoomInVanilla: Zoom in to see vanilla zones.
IGUI_ZoneAPI_DoubleClickEdit: Double-click a value to edit it.
IGUI_ZoneAPI_SelectZone: Select a zone in the list or click one on the map.
IGUI_ZoneAPI_Hint_Draw: Click and drag to draw the zone. Right-click / Esc to cancel.
IGUI_ZoneAPI_Hint_Selected: Drag corners/edges to resize, the centre square to move. Del removes.
